validated_results.title: Association between heavy metal exposure and epigenetic modifications in patients with urinary bladder cancer.
validated_results.reason: The study measured heavy metal concentrations and epigenetic modifications in blood, urine, and tissue of prevalent bladder cancer patients versus controls to explore molecular mechanisms and gene expression changes, without any estimate of chromium exposure and risk of developing bladder cancer.

validated_results.title: Association between heavy metal exposure and epigenetic modifications in patients with urinary bladder cancer.
validated_results.reason: For urothelial bladder carcinoma the report likewise presents tissue/blood/urine metal levels alongside epigenetic and gene-expression alterations in existing patients, providing mechanistic rather than incidence evidence for chromium.
